content: Close the W0122 producer-ingress boundary by adding one runtime-owned capture-and-submit entry that snapshots Coordinator metadata at observation time and routes admin reset, VFIO-user reset, disconnect, and daemon restart through the existing normalizer and Coordinator. Add host-independent regressions for every supported producer kind, stale snapshot behavior, and malformed/unknown rejection without changing the stable transport wire or C ABI.

Convergence restricted capture_and_submit_external_event to the four immediate producer kinds named by the objective. Admin add/remove and delayed QMP events remain on the pre-captured ExternalEvent path; unsupported routing stops before Coordinator mutation, and an authority advance after observation remains visible as Result::Stale rather than triggering recapture.

Content revision 6152efa7d9ca8f0b28e6ec9ed6d9617e8377fb67 passed the focused runtime-lifecycle-dispatch test 1/1, a complete dev build, and the full dev CTest 85/85. The stable S0123 change inventory excluded two foreign Vulkan guidance packets; git diff --check and Agent records also passed.

Closed S0123 after recording P20260831-089. The runtime-owned immediate ingress helper, supported-kind guard, malformed/unsupported checks, and stale-observation regression are complete; actual reset/disconnect/restart producer call-site wiring, staged fault injection, and live qualification remain W0122 work.
